results.name: Live Preview: seven native occurrences; embeds/code/Markdown links excluded
hover highlights exactly one connector and its source
command creates an exact native Wikilink and preserves surrounding text
single transaction undo/redo also removes/restores the derived card
Esc from picker never changes a character
changed source while choosing is rejected without wrapping another range
drag handle → right margin → picker creates lossless Chinese alias
drag onto body is canceled without a modal or write
Reading view maps each source occurrence once and never shows an edit handle
Source mode uses actual visible source token positions
unresolved card does not create or open a missing file
resolved card opens its exact existing target
split panes stay scoped to their own files
narrow panes safely hide cards without horizontal overflow
unhandled HTML is recognized but never launched externally by the card
switching the active file cancels a pending picker without a write
multiple editor selections are rejected without opening a picker
left-margin drag temporarily places the new card on the left
keyboard focus and Enter open an existing card target
Reading view distinguishes identical aliases in Markdown, references and Wikilinks
long-note scrolling renders only visible anchors and no floating old links
rename/delete events refresh resolution without rewriting source
native light/dark theme switching keeps cards readable
table selections are refused rather than writing an unescaped alias pipe
display toggle only saves UI preferences and never changes Markdown
disable/enable cleans every overlay and highlight, then restores existing reading links
